PluginEnricherParam.value: SELECT UPPER(TRIM(st.all_state)) || '-' || TRIM(ct.country_id::text) AS lookup_column, CASE WHEN ct.country_cd IN ('AU', 'IN', 'BR', 'US', 'CA', 'MX') THEN COALESCE(st.state_id, -1) ELSE -1 END AS output_column FROM (SELECT state_cd AS all_state, state_id, f_country_id FROM gd_state UNION ALL SELECT state_name AS all_state, state_id,f_country_id FROM gd_state) st LEFT OUTER JOIN gd_country ct ON COALESCE(st.f_country_id, -1) = ct.country_id
